arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Blanchard argued the dual banking system exemplifies cooperative federalism.
Mr. Srinivasan asserted the issue involves conflict preemption, not field preemption.
Mr. Long stated that undisputed principles help focus the legal issue before the Court.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The outcome defines the boundary between state and federal banking regulation. It determines whether states can inspect and limit mortgage operations of national bank subsidiaries. This affects consumer protection and the structure of the national banking system.
